summary: End-to-end validation of the fine-grained admin permission split. Verified the ~129-item permissions catalog (incl. all 30 new keys, no duplicates), the 7 ready-made admin role presets endpoint (idempotent — second call: created=0 updated=7, all 7 names present in /api/roles), fine-grained enforcement on EMP-100 against 15 endpoints (activity-logs read/delete, trash, student activate/reset/bulk-activate, hr card print-settings/batch-preview, fee receipts read/write, admin diagnose-roles, semesters create, export-students, admin/fix-user, grant system_tools+export_students then re-login and re-check), and admin + dean umbrella regressions. UI verified: /manage-roles admin-presets-card renders with all 7 preset role names, and the user-permissions editor shows all 7 new Arabic category headers (الطلاب — عمليات متقدمة، السجلات والمحذوفات، أدوات الصيانة، المحاضرات والجدول، الاستيراد والتصدير، الهيكل الأكاديمي، المعلمون — عمليات متقدمة). SideMenu.tsx guards 'سجلات النشاط' with view_activity_logs and 'سلة المحذوفات' with manage_trash/purge_trash as spec'd. 24/24 backend tests pass. EMP-100 and the roles collection were fully restored at teardown.

minor.issue: Permission check runs AFTER DB lookup → returns 404 for non-existent receipt even when caller is unauthorized. Prefer failing fast with 403. (Non-functional; used /fees/receipts/bulk-review for the enforcement test.)

FastAPI validates Pydantic body before dependency-level permission check → returns 422 for malformed bodies even when caller lacks permission. Minor info-disclosure; tests use valid bodies to confirm 403.

Sending {role_id: null} is silently ignored (user remains attached to prior role_id). Had to send a concrete fallback role_id (employee system role) to detach from the test role. Document or honor null explicitly.

issues: Console warnings only (non-blocking): deprecated 'shadow*' / 'pointerEvents' style props, Require cycle in HR EmployeeFormModal ↔ HrSelect — pre-existing, unrelated to this feature.

action_items: (Optional) Move permission check in /fees/receipts/{id}/approve and /reject BEFORE the DB lookup so unauthorized callers consistently see 403 rather than 404.
(Optional) In PUT /api/users/{id}, decide and document semantics of role_id=null (currently a no-op).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 19,133 lines — far above the 700-line rule-of-thumb. The new fine-grained rewrites (~90 routes) are inline; please consider extracting admin/HR/fee domains into their own routers (several already exist under routes/*.py). The /roles/admin-presets endpoint belongs with /roles/hr-presets in a presets module.

FULL_PERMISSION_MAPPING + has_permission expansion is correct, but the pattern 'if not has_permission(x, fine_key) and (<old condition>)' is repeated ~90× — a small decorator or dependency (require_any_permission) would cut noise and prevent future deviations.

ADMIN_ROLE_PRESETS: preset_key is written but not surfaced in GET /api/roles response — if the frontend wants to badge preset roles differently it can't. Consider including preset_key in the role projection.

The alert() handling in manage-roles.tsx inside RN-Web triggers window.alert dialogs — fine for admin tooling but makes automated UI testing brittle (dialog must be registered before click). Prefer a toast/banner for consistency with the rest of the app.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (manage-roles card + 7 preset names + 7 category headers all verified)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed. Test fixture creates a temporary role 'TEST_fine_role_perm_split' and assigns it to EMP-100, then on teardown reassigns EMP-100 back to the 'موظف' (employee) system role (698a4cffbc4813c8639d66d4) and deletes the temp role. Admin presets endpoint was called twice (idempotent) — the 7 preset roles now exist in the roles collection, which is the expected target state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_permissions_split.py (pytest). On a cold DB where EMP-100 had never been touched the fixture snapshots role_id/permissions and restores them; on re-runs it detects the stale TEST role and falls back to the employee system role. If a prior run leaves EMP-100 attached to a 'TEST_fine_role_perm_split' role, run the fixture once (any pytest invocation) — teardown cleans up. The 7 preset admin roles persist in Mongo after this iteration (that is intended).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. The only observed deviations (approve 404-before-403, PUT role_id:null no-op) are minor code-quality items, not regressions.
